description: A customizable date picker component used to create date inputs. Adheres to WCAG 2.2 standards.

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: Indicates that the input should have a border.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the input.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Whether the form control is disabled.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: Feedback to render below the input.

properties.name: inputId
properties.description: The ID of the start input in single mode. In range mode, the end input id is `{inputId}-end` (or `{generated-id}-end` when omitted). There is no separate prop for the end input id.

properties.name: inputTabIndex
properties.description: Determine the control's relative ordering for sequential focus navigation (typically with the Tab key).

properties.name: label
properties.description: The text to display within the label.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum date value. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

properties.name: min
properties.description: Minimum date value. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the form control. In range mode, the end input name is `{name}-end`. There is no separate prop for the end input name.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Whether the value is editable.

properties.name: required
properties.description: A value is required or must be checked for the form to be submittable.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the input.

properties.name: format
properties.description: The date format for display and input.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The selected date in single mode. In range mode (`type="range"`), the start date of the range. Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty string when unset.

properties.name: weekStartDay
properties.description: The first day of the week for the calendar display

properties.name: showWeekNumbers
properties.description: Displays ISO 8601 week numbers in the calendar. Week numbers are calculated with Monday as the first day of the week.

properties.name: hideOverflowDates
properties.description: When omitted, defaults to `true` in range mode and `false` in single mode.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Activates range mode. `value` is the start date; `endValue` is the end date.

properties.name: endValue
properties.description: The end date in range mode (`type="range"`). Must match the `format` prop pattern (or the locale-derived format when unset) or ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty string when unset. Ignored in single mode.

events.name: inputBlur
events.description: Event emitted when the input loses focus. In range mode, `detail.field` is `'start'` or `'end'`.

events.name: inputChange
events.description: Event emitted when the input value changes. `target.value` is always ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or empty string when incomplete or invalid. In range mode, `detail.field` is `'start'` or `'end'`.

events.name: inputFocus
events.description: Event emitted when the input gains focus. In range mode, `detail.field` is `'start'` or `'end'`.

events.name: calendarMonthChange
events.description: Event emitted when the start (or single-mode) calendar month selection changes.

events.name: calendarYearChange
events.description: Event emitted when the start (or single-mode) calendar year selection changes.

events.name: endCalendarMonthChange
events.description: Event emitted when the end calendar month selection changes in range mode.

events.name: endCalendarYearChange
events.description: Event emitted when the end calendar year selection changes in range mode.

events.name: rangeChange
events.description: Event emitted when a complete date range is selected in range mode.

examples.basic:
<style>
        div[id^='story--components-forms-date--default'] {
          min-height: 400px;
          width: 300px;
        }
      </style>
      <modus-wc-date
        aria-label="Date input"
        ?bordered=${args.bordered}
        custom-class=${ifDefined(args['custom-class'])}
        ?disabled=${args.disabled}
        end-value=${ifDefined(args['end-value'])}
        .feedback=${args.feedback}
        format=${ifDefined(args.format)}
        .hideOverflowDates=${args['hide-overflow-dates']}
        input-id=${ifDefined(args['input-id'])}
        input-tab-index=${ifDefined(args['input-tab-index'])}
        label=${ifDefined(args.label)}
        max=${ifDefined(args.max)}
        min=${ifDefined(args.min)}
        name=${ifDefined(args.name)}
        ?read-only=${args['read-only']}
        ?required=${args.required}
        ?show-week-numbers=${args['show-week-numbers']}
        size=${ifDefined(args.size)}
        type=${ifDefined(args.type)}
        .value=${args.value}
        week-start-day=${ifDefined(args['week-start-day'])}
      ></modus-wc-date>
